title: Today's hottest physics papers on arXiv

sections.title: Incipient superconductivity and tunable Chern insulators in twisted Bernal bilayer-trilayer graphene
sections.abstract: The authors report a gate-tunable twisted graphene platform combining Chern-insulator states with pockets of incipient, phase-coherent superconductivity.
sections.claimed_result: Chern insulators coexist with an incipient-superconductivity pocket whose critical-current signatures are tunable by displacement field and magnetic field.
sections.evidence_type: experimental; twisted Bernal bilayer-trilayer graphene transport
sections.caveat: Resistance does not reach zero, so the result does not establish bulk zero-resistance superconductivity.

sections.title: Observation of universal hierarchical relaxation in a quantum simulator
sections.abstract: A trapped-ion quantum simulator experimentally demonstrates a predicted hierarchy of relaxation exponents for autocorrelators in the diffusive regime.
sections.claimed_result: The relaxation-overlap inequality is extended to multiple conservation laws and its predicted hierarchy is observed in a trapped-ion simulator.
sections.evidence_type: experimental; trapped-ion quantum simulator and autocorrelation measurements
sections.caveat: The demonstration is limited to the diffusive regime and the simulator's accessible operators and conservation laws.

sections.title: Multi-messenger and multi-band signal from first-order phase transitions in proto-neutron stars
sections.abstract: Model-agnostic proto-neutron-star calculations predict correlated kHz and MHz gravitational-wave emission plus a delayed neutrino burst from an accretion-driven first-order phase transition.
sections.claimed_result: A first-order transition can produce correlated multi-band gravitational waves and a delayed neutrino burst whose timing probes transition physics.
sections.evidence_type: computational/theoretical; proto-neutron-star evolution with a constrained equation-of-state ensemble
sections.caveat: The signal is a forecast dependent on the equation-of-state ensemble, transition dynamics, and channel detectability.

sections.title: Two-rung ladder: H0 from Tip of the Red Giant Branch and geometric anchors alone
sections.abstract: A TRGB distance ladder calibrated with the Large Magellanic Cloud and NGC 4258 gives H0 estimates whose uncertainty is dominated by local velocity-field reconstruction rather than TRGB calibration.
sections.claimed_result: Equal weighting gives H0 = 68.4 ± 5.9 km/s/Mpc, while evidence weighting gives 72.3 ± 2.6 km/s/Mpc; the ladder cannot yet arbitrate the Hubble tension.
sections.evidence_type: observational/data analysis; TRGB hosts, geometric anchors, redshifts, and local velocity fields
sections.caveat: The result is sensitive to field-to-field scatter and finite sampling of the reconstruction posterior.

sections.title: A Narrow Neutrino Window for the LZ Event
sections.abstract: The authors propose a two-step atmospheric-neutrino upscattering mechanism that could explain LZ's 248 keV recoil while avoiding constraints from lighter-target neutrino experiments.
sections.claimed_result: A narrow two-step nu-to-N1-to-N2 process could yield an O(1) LZ event while kinematically evading other neutrino targets.
sections.evidence_type: theoretical/forecast; kinematic analysis and dark-sector model proposal
sections.caveat: This is a model explanation for one event, not a detection, and requires a narrow energy window and specific interactions.

sections.title: Limits on Primordial Black Hole Evaporation from LUX-ZEPLIN
sections.abstract: The paper argues that Hawking-boosted dark matter from evaporating primordial black holes would overproduce low-energy recoils, converting LZ's null low-energy search into stringent PBH abundance limits.
sections.claimed_result: For PBH masses around 2 × 10^11 g, f_PBH greater than about 10^-6 is excluded at 90% confidence under the paper's assumptions.
sections.evidence_type: theoretical/computational; LZ recoil constraints with EFT operators and inelastic transitions
sections.caveat: The bound depends on the assumed scattering operators, evaporation flux, and interpretation of the LZ event and null region.
